chiSiamo.title: Who we are
chiSiamo.body:
We are a group of students united by a passion for Bitcoin and economics. Our goal is to spread knowledge, promote critical thinking, and build a community focused on a freer economic future.

Association recognised by Università della Svizzera italiana (USI), Lugano.

missione.title: Mission
missione.body: Spread knowledge about Bitcoin and decentralized technologies, promoting critical thinking and innovation among university students.
